parts.gloss: if they obtain / if they can

literal: Even those who are unlearned are very excellent, if they can manage to remain without speaking before the learned.
translation: Even those who are unlearned are highly excellent, if they can manage to remain silent in the presence of the learned.
modern: கற்றவர்களின் முன்னிலையில் பேசாமல் அமைதியாக இருக்க முடிந்தால், கல்வி கற்காதவர்களும் மிகவும் நல்லவர்களே ஆவர்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the value of silence for those who lack education. It states that even unlearned individuals can be considered highly excellent if they possess the self-restraint to remain silent in the presence of scholars. By not speaking, they prevent their lack of knowledge from being exposed, thereby preserving their dignity. The phrase 'நனிநல்லர்' (highly excellent) shows how silence can elevate their worth, while 'சொல்லாதிருக்கப் பெறின்' (if they can manage to remain silent) emphasizes the self-control required to do so.
